configuration: Periodic cell padding; float64 output, SAB_REPEATS=1, fixed deterministic geometry, and the parameters documented in runner.py.
observable: SOAP arrays for orthogonal and equivalent monoclinic cells at three sizes and cutoffs, plus residuals.
default_vs_upstream: Adapted from the corresponding official test into a self-contained deterministic numerical observable; breadth is retained while redundant parametrizations are reduced.
variant: ic/variant changes one active binary64 input value from 1.0 to 1.0000000000000004 (two ulps); the value perturbs a coordinate or, for radial orthonormality, r_cut.
altbuild: none: the initial Debian image intentionally carries one GCC build; cross-build numerical floors will be represented by calibration evidence when available.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative-build floor is available; the Docker nominal/variant calibration measured a 2.776e-16 spread.

warrant: Orthogonal and equivalent monoclinic periodic features and residuals are compared pointwise at atol=1e-8 and rtol=1e-6, exactly the pinned upstream padding test's scale. The measured Docker perturbation spread is 2.776e-16; a 0.1 single-entry fault was rejected, and extension, wrapping, or duplicate-neighbour faults exceed the approved bound.
